what_this_is: the A3 motor torque-speed envelope and the joint-to-motor map, which is the authority mechanical admission needs and did not have

redistribution.vendor_statement: Agibot: the raw data may not be open-sourced, the curves may
redistribution.consequence: the 20 raw bench CSVs stay in gitignored vendor_assets/agibot/a3_motor_tn_reference_20260804/; only the derived envelope, summary, joint map and training limits are tracked here

provenance.coverage: 5 motor families x 2 units x forward+reverse = 20 bench CSVs
provenance.units: output shaft after the reducer; speed rad/s (raw CSV is RPM), torque N*m

envelope_model.form: two-segment, symmetric in sign, queried on abs(speed)
formula: vb < v < vz        -> T_limit = T0 * (vz - v) / (vz - vb)
envelope_model.note: this describes MOTOR capability and does not replace a joint's own effort limit; for serial joints the usable torque is the smaller of the two

joint_coverage.parallel_caveat: waist and both ankles are 2x2 parallel mechanisms; joint_velocity = J*motor_velocity and motor_torque = J^T*joint_torque with a pose-dependent J that this package does not supply, so their T-N cannot be checked in joint space

independent_limits_are_not_an_envelope.explanation: the training config's effort_limit_sim and velocity_limit_sim are INDEPENDENT, drawing a rectangle whose corner necessarily lies outside the coupled curve; a corner outside the envelope is the documented picture, not a defect
independent_limits_are_not_an_envelope.why_it_matters: admission must test the actual per-frame (speed, torque) pair against the curve, not compare the two corner numbers
